question.html:
Consider the following statements about the use of nuclear fission in electricity production:

I. Products that are produced in the fuel rods of a nuclear fission reactor have very long half-lives and as a result, produce extremely high amounts of heat and must be continuously cooled after disposal. 

II. Control rods are introduced into the moderator of the reactor in order to absorb excess neutrons. 

III. Cleaning materials and protective clothing used in nuclear power plants are not highly radioactive and can be disposed of as regular trash after a relatively short storage period.

Which of these statements are correct?

  1. I and II only
  2. I and III only
  3. II and III only
  4. I, II and III
